title: As You Like It presented by The Public - Mobile Unit #asyoulikeit #th...
transcript: It's officially free Shakespeare season in New York, and this summer, The Public is presenting three of them, at least one of which will be in or around your neighborhood. Their small but mighty Mobile Unit production of As You Like It is touring across all five boroughs through the end of the month, and it's a delight. A comedy where the main plot is a will-they-won't-they between the two main characters is far from a novel concept. That said, this production decorates it wonderfully with colorful costumes, original music, and hilarious double performances from the supporting cast. The conflict is, all things considered, pretty minimal and pretty low stakes, but the journey of these characters invoke resonant themes that feel especially meaningful right now. In act of radical love and radical optimism, this production poses: In a world that's cold and harsh, why not be kind and gentle? When it's so easy to overthink, why not be hopeful? Why not invite the possibility of something good happening? For all its earnestness, it's still a Shakespeare — there are plenty of shady jabs to go around. As a light-hearted, Shakespearean summer rom-com, it delivers. As You Like It is coming to your borough sooner than later. With that, another program for my collection.
